scoring_justification: T_SRT is recomputed from magnetization_curve.csv by linear interpolation of the crossing point — fully self-contained T1 recompute. Monotonic trends are verified directly from the curve. The free-energy landscape check uses T3 structural audit because re-running the full Wang-Landau in the verifier is infeasible, yet the key structural claim (low-region spanning both perpendicular- and in-plane-dominated states) is checkable from the agent's output.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference T_SRT range [0.25, 0.35] J and trend expectations for the magnetization curve. The paper states T_SRT ≈ 0.3 J for cases 1-3; Fig. 2 caption specifically gives T_SRT = 0.33 J for case 2.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: Section 4 (Results) states 'the SRT temperature T_SRT ... is around 0.3 J in all of the three cases'. Fig. 2 caption explicitly states 'T_SRT is 0.33 J' for case 2. The trend m_perp > m_par at low T and m_perp < m_par at T=0.4 J is visible in Fig. 1 and described in the text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: The tolerance window [0.25, 0.35] is centered on 0.30 J with ±0.05 J to absorb legitimate MC implementation variation while excluding values far from the reported result. The trend expectations m_perp > m_par at T=0.025 and m_perp < m_par at T=0.4 are the qualitative behaviors the paper reports across all three single-domain cases.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported quantities and observed trends. The magnetization crossing and T_SRT value are the primary headline result being reproduced.

outputs.description: Temperature-dependent perpendicular and in-plane magnetizations; the hidden checker recomputes T_SRT from this data and verifies monotonic trends.

schema.description: A single float value in units of J.

outputs.description: The agent-reported SRT temperature; the checker recomputes T_SRT from magnetization_curve.csv and compares it to this value with a hidden tolerance.
Free-energy landscape at T_SRT; the checker verifies that the low free-energy region (F_diff ≤ T_SRT) spans both perpendicular-dominated and in-plane-dominated magnetization states.

output_contract.notes: All outputs are expected to be generated by the agent from the described simulations. The checker will not require external datasets; it will recompute quantities from the agent's artifacts and compare them against hidden reference values derived from the paper.

steps.description: Recompute T_SRT from the magnetization curve by linear interpolation of the crossing point where m_perp = m_par. Verify T_SRT is within [0.25, 0.35] J with graded partial credit outside. Verify monotonic trends: m_perp > m_par at the lowest temperature, and m_perp < m_par at T ≈ 0.4 J.

Verify the agent-reported TSRT.txt value is self-consistent with the T_SRT recomputed from magnetization_curve.csv (within ±0.05 J). This is a low-weight consistency gate; the main T_SRT scoring is on the recomputed value from the curve.

Structural audit of the free-energy landscape. Using the T_SRT recomputed from the magnetization curve, identify all bins where F_diff ≤ T_SRT. Verify that this low-free-energy region contains at least one bin with m_perp ≥ 0.5 (perpendicular-dominated state) and at least one bin with m_par ≥ 0.5 (in-plane-dominated state), confirming the paper's claim that the low-energy region spans both magnetization regimes.

structural_conditions.perp_dominated_in_low_region: exists bin with F_diff ≤ T_SRT and m_perp_bin ≥ 0.5
structural_conditions.inplane_dominated_in_low_region: exists bin with F_diff ≤ T_SRT and m_par_bin ≥ 0.5
